name: phase_guided_slots_v2
purpose: Redesign the phase_guided_slots task so it creates GENUINE bounded-memory pressure (distinct slots, saturation, eviction, multi-fact retrieval) and validate that plain slots C fail through real eviction BEFORE Phase is tested again.

frozen_contract.changes: dataset, task protocol, instrumentation, and experiment harness only
frozen_contract.match_threshold: set as an INSTANCE attribute on GuidedBoundedSlots (module source unchanged)

gating_rule: Phase arms (D / D-no-guid) may not be evaluated until Stage A PASSES: plain slots C must be capacity-limited and losing relevant evidence through real eviction.

stageA_gate.shortcut_controls: value/target corruption collapses accuracy; key/query corruption materially harms

arms.D: local + Phase-guided bounded slots (Stage B only)
arms.D-no-guid: D architecture, Phase guidance zeroed (Stage B only)

files.memory_trace.py: read-only faithful GuidedBoundedSlots trace with oracle identities
files.train_eval.py: answer CE + per-fact-anchor write BCE (balanced) + metrics
files.task_validator.py: PCfg + train_arm + Stage A validity gate
files.run_task_validation.py: Stage A driver (A, C only) across pressure configs + seeds
files.run_phase_comparison.py: Stage B driver (D vs C) — gated on Stage A PASS
files.guided_models_oracle.py: arms A/C/D/D-no-guid over oracle memory; Phase only as retention signal; compressed write
files.oracle_eval.py: oracle training/curriculum/eval; accuracy split by target survival
files.run_oracle_stageB.py: oracle Stage B — Phase as retention (gated on Stage A PASS)

approach.negative_result: Neural identity-key addressing (key-diversity + curriculum) collapses or shortcuts and cannot isolate capacity — documented in the report §2a.
approach.adopted: ORACLE composite-identity addressing (oracle_slots.OracleSlots): allocation + query lookup are structurally correct by entity id; value encoding, retention, eviction, and decode stay learned.
approach.memory_dependence_proof: acc|evicted ~= chance (structural: evicted identity -> empty read).

result.stageA: PASS on redesign criteria (survives->high, evicted->chance ~0.02-0.04, overall acc~=survival) across 3 seeds; C acc 0.50/0.31/0.24 at 1.5x/2x/3x.
result.stageB: Phase-as-retention gives NO benefit: D-C survival = -0.025; relevance probe Phase +0.06 F1 over local (near chance). Corroborates v1 dilution finding under a valid capacity test.
